producerReview.decision: current flat object-flow storyboard for primary review
producerReview.observation: Two front-on flat app moments with tall warm-white PDF, full room behind the interface, compact composer and small red portrait source cover. Left cover is lifted from an empty header outline; the draft edge shows reversible target. Right retains same page and draft with a small source chip and x, plus bottom-edge return/bookmark strip. No arrows, unexplained pointing, physical laptop, human figure, or readable fake author list remain.
producerReview.limits: Illustrated message copy and page marks are synthetic UI samples, never actual PDF content/model output. The main-state v1 is clearer for a full desktop viewport; v3 is a process board only. Still art does not prove dragging, interruption, cancel persistence or source-owner behavior.

runtimeUse: UI relationships only, never whole-screen bitmap or character/source document.
